items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 16 May 2026 11:14am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 16 May 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland as a frontal zone continues to clear the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

West or southwest 2 to 4, increasing force 5 in places this afternoon, then veering west 4 or 5 this evening and occasionally force 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the south later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle clearing tonight as it becomes fair.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, veering west or southwest 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Occasional showers becoming isolated later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.
